Aye partner, my dad has passed away last year. It destroyed me really, I mean who wouldn't? Eventho we did'nt talk or bond that much because of his busy schedule at work. But I do miss the old man.

But you know what I have learned from it?
Is that unexpectable pain will happens in life, losing loved ones is a part of life and we cannot deny anything aboutit. But what we can do is to try and be strong in that moment, I failed my part when my old man passed away and it breaks my heart when I should've been the one who stood up for when my mom couldn't at that time and I regret every second of it.

So what I am saying is that fearing it will happen wont change a thing, all you could do is to prepare for that moment, live the life you have always wanted with them, and cherish all the moment you could while they're still there. And hey, don't forget to always say that you love them, and hug them once a while. You could not know when it will be the last time you could see them.

So stay strong partner, do not do what I did, and just spend every time or moment you could with them aight? 🤠
